{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_counts = df[patient_duplicates]['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Show how many times each patient appears
print("Duplicate patient counts:")
print(dup_counts)

# Count total number of duplicate rows
print(f"\nTotal duplicate rows: {patient_duplicates.sum()}")

# Check sample_seq to see if higher values are the latest
print("\nSample sequence for a few duplicated patients:")
print(df[patient_duplicates].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq']).groupby('patient_id').tail(1)[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']])"}
